@@info: Keys that exist in <en> but not in <uk>.
The values below are the en source text — replace them with uk translations.
You do not have to translate all of them; leave out what you are unsure about and open a PR.
A maintainer then runs 'npm run i18n:apply' to merge this file into messages/uk.json.
Anything still missing afterwards simply renders in en at runtime.
phone_selector_search_help_substring: Matches any part of the brand or device name.
phone_selector_search_help_commas: Separate devices with commas to look up several at once.
phone_selector_search_help_cross_site: In results from other databases, only the sites carrying every device you named are listed.
phone_selector_search_help_brands: Search narrows whatever you have picked in the brand list.
eq_constraint_select_title: EQ constraint preset — limits bands, filter types, and frequency / Q / gain ranges
eq_channel_shared_hint: + {count} shared band(s) also apply to this channel.
eq_channel_device_peq_shared_only: Sent {count} shared band(s). This device has no per-channel EQ, so {skipped} left/right band(s) were skipped.
